scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how the side effects include impaired attention and memory. These side effects have made it difficult for her at her desk job. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would give her a severe headache. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I force-feed the medication to my aunt against her will, my aunt will continue to live as is. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience a severe headache.
choice: I decide to force-feed the medication to my aunt against her will
outcomes: My aunt avoids the severe headache
My aunt experiences the medication's impaired attention side effect
My aunt continues to have difficulty at her desk job
My aunt experiences distress from being force-fed
